**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Re-design D2 PR2 revert-resolution predicate after judgment-round-1 NOT-APPROVED. Owner sent it back to DESIGN §3.2 (defect is the predicate, not the code). Path-scoped `P∩D=∅` is dead; replace with a fail-closed content predicate; code follows the predicate.

## Instructions (owner ruling, ratified)
- Judge candidates on the axis "which direction does it fail?", not "which is more robust". False "resolved" masks a violation forever (catastrophe); false "not resolved" → LOUD → human gate (safe).
- Every §7.1 attack row needs a forged fixture + mutation bar, on MERGE-COMMIT topology (brain merges PRs with --merge). Forge attacks, never reason them.
- C4 invariant: the claim is "∃R that inverted O exactly", NEVER "payload not on disk".

## Discoveries (all forged against real git, scratchpad/forge*.mjs)
- path-scoped fails OPEN on a legit `git mv` (no attacker); path∧blob also fails open on rename+modify.
- `git patch-id --stable` RATIFIED then DISQUALIFIED: ignores indentation whitespace with no off-switch (ws.mjs: `add "PAY"` == `add "        PAY"`).
- Chosen mechanism: normDiff = hardened `git diff` (`-c diff.algorithm=myers -c diff.renames=false -c core.attributesFile=/dev/null --no-textconv --no-ext-diff --no-renames --binary -U3`), drop /^@@ / and /^index /, rest byte-exact. resolved(O,tip) ⟺ normDiff(O^1,O) non-empty AND ∃ first-parent merge R∈(O,tip]: normDiff(R,R^1)==normDiff(O^1,O).
- C1: diff:=X^1..X first-parent (combined merge diff is EMPTY). C2: real D2 loop (offender merge → git revert -m1 → PR merged --merge) resolves true. F-1 empty diff → guard. F-2 binary needs --binary. F-3 path in header. F-4 `.gitattributes -diff` at tip rewrites old offender's rendering → neutralized by `.git/info/attributes = "* diff"` (higher precedence) + --binary. Blast radius = 3 lines (U3); real brain history: 105 merges, 0 revert-trailers → human-gate load ≈ 0.

## Accomplished
- design.md: §3.0–3.6 (new §3.6 soundness claim + C4 invariant), §3.1 re-judged on fail-direction axis (patch-id row REJECTED), §3.2 new predicate + rendering-security-surface, §3.3 isReverterOf, §3.5 mechanism B updated, §7.1 A1–A6 + T1–T11 (each fixture + mutation), R-2 reframed.
- tasks.md PR3: isReverterOf on normDiff base (C5), stale P∩D fixed, root-commit fail-closed structured task 3.3.5/3.3.6 (point 7).
- resolution.mjs + .test.mjs rewritten (whole-commit diff-inversion, hardenDiffRendering, 28 tests). Self-verified: 57/57 postmerge green, root-commit throws→fail-closed, C4 invariant holds, size ~150 (149 added) < 400.

## Next Steps
- RE-JUDGMENT (owner or judgment-day skill). Nothing committed/pushed yet.
- Residual: root-commit structured fail-closed is a PR3 task (predicate currently throws→exit-2, safe but not yet structured); T4/T5/T6 now have dedicated forge fixtures.

## Relevant Files
- brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/resolution.mjs — new predicate
- brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/resolution.test.mjs — 28 tests from forge scripts
- openspec/changes/issue-259-d2/design.md — §3, §7.1 rewritten
- openspec/changes/issue-259-d2/tasks.md — PR3 updates
- ~/.claude/projects/-home-gandalf-IA-brain/design-docs/d2-pr2-revert-resolution-redesign.md — full decision record
- scratchpad/forge*.mjs — all forged evidence
